def solve():
    target = 260
    held = 380
    held_vintage = 2016
    min_vintage = 2020
    legacy_price = Q("3.5")
    bundle_size = 50
    purchase_price = Q("15.75")
    resale_discount = Q("0.05")

    # Vintage eligibility test for held credits
    eligible = held_vintage >= min_vintage
    if eligible:
        applied_held = min(held, target)
        excess_held = held - applied_held
        legacy_proceeds = Q(0)
    else:
        applied_held = 0
        excess_held = 0
        legacy_proceeds = held * legacy_price  # all held sold at legacy price

    # Remaining shortfall covered by fewest whole bundles
    shortfall = target - applied_held
    bundles = -(-shortfall // bundle_size) if shortfall > 0 else 0
    bought = bundles * bundle_size
    bundle_excess = bought - shortfall

    # Surplus = bundle excess + excess eligible held credits
    surplus = bundle_excess + excess_held
    purchase_cost = bought * purchase_price
    resale_price = purchase_price * (1 - resale_discount)
    resale_proceeds = surplus * resale_price

    # Net cash outlay = purchase cost - resale - legacy proceeds
    net_outlay = purchase_cost - resale_proceeds - legacy_proceeds

    return {
        "final": net_outlay,
        "applied_held_credits": Q(applied_held),
        "bundles_purchased": Q(bundles),
        "surplus_credits": Q(surplus),
    }
